column1: # WRN-Helicase case study — machine-readable data manifest (single source of truth for fetch.sh).
# One row per artifact. Tab-separated. Columns:
#             raw     — fetched from a public origin URL by fetch.sh
#                       fetch.sh copies from the in-repo fallback path if present,
#             derived — produced from another artifact by an extract/ script
#   md5     figshare-supplied md5 (verified on download), or "-" if none published
#   sha256  Eigenius content address of the local copy (the authority; == the
#           PinnedExternalFile IRI hash used in the demo + chain provenance)
#   dest    path under data/ where the artifact lives
# Human-readable provenance narrative (what each is used for): see MANIFEST.md.
